metadata.description: FinOps skills and agents for Azure SRE Agent

plugins.name: finops
plugins.description: Read-only FinOps pack for Azure SRE Agent: fifteen skills including dynamic managed-scope enforcement and deterministic Live Report rendering, plus an installer that adds the investigator agent and scheduled reviews (a plugin install alone imports only the skills). Budget planning can generate a governed shell script for a human to review and run manually.
